title: Credentials
subtitle: Manage access credentials (username/password, tokens, SSH keys)

form.cardDescription: Add a new credential to the system

userPassword.ntlmHelp: Format: LM:NT or NT hash only
userPassword.warning: You must provide at least a password OR an NTLM hash

kerberos.ccacheHelpA: Select the ccache file (e.g., krb5cc_1000, output of
kerberos.ccacheHelpC: ). The content is sent as base64.
kerberos.ccacheBase64Label: … or paste the ccache as base64
kerberos.warning: The ticket must be valid (not expired). Username and domain are derived from the ccache when not provided.

token.label: Token *
token.hint: A plain text token (e.g. a GitHub Personal Access Token) used to authenticate Git operations and API searches.

anonymous.title: Anonymous authentication (null session)
anonymous.description: This credential type has no username or password. When selected on a server, the scan will attempt an anonymous SMB session (empty username and password). Useful for servers that allow anonymous access to shares.

edit.ccacheReplaceHelp: Select a new ccache file to replace the current one, or paste the base64 below (leave blank to keep).
